breakpilot.bridgeUrl.description: Optional explicit BreakPilot IDE Bridge WebSocket URL. Leave empty to follow .breakpilot/bridge.json.

breakpilot.safeInspectionsMode.description: Controls how BreakPilot remembers safe paused-state inspections.

breakpilot.debugControlsMode.description: Controls how BreakPilot remembers continue and step approvals.

breakpilot.trustedProject.description: Trust this workspace for BreakPilot safe inspection approvals.

breakpilot.allowPersistentHighRiskApprov.description: Allow narrow project-level allowlists for high-risk evaluate requests.

breakpilot.allowedActions.description: High-risk action names that may be auto-approved when persistent approvals are enabled.

breakpilot.allowedExpressionPatterns.description: Regular expressions or substrings for high-risk evaluate expressions that may be auto-approved when persistent approvals are enabled.

breakpilot.allowlistTrustedProjectsOnly.description: Only apply persistent high-risk allowlists when the workspace is trusted.
